action: I'm clear — out of the nest and running, the dog gone but me still breathing.

phases.text: I'm clear — out of the nest and running, the dog gone but me still breathing.

You keep sprinting, the nest falling away behind you, and for one stride, glancing back out of old habit, you see the dog pelting along at your heel — then you remember, and it isn't there, though the road holds a line of paw-prints running alongside yours all the same.

outcomes.text: You outpace it — the nest and whatever came out of it fall away behind you, the road opening ahead.
You keep your legs under you and put real distance behind you, lungs burning, the fog closing the gap shut.
Something is still coming — you feel it more than hear it, closing fast enough that you have to find your footing and turn to meet it.
The road forks out of the fog sooner than it should, the Crossing Signpost rearing up and forcing a choice mid-stride.
Your own footfalls stop matching your steps, a beat behind or ahead of you, and you can't tell which.
You glance back for the dog out of habit and for one stride you see it running beside you — then remember, and it isn't there, and the road remembers it too.
